tasks.name: SMILE_LEFT
tasks.instruction: Smile with the LEFT mouth corner; keep your head still.

tasks.name: SMILE_RIGHT
tasks.instruction: Smile with the RIGHT mouth corner; keep your head still.

tasks.name: SMILE_BOTH
tasks.instruction: Smile with BOTH mouth corners; keep your head still.

tasks.name: PUFF_LEFT
tasks.instruction: Gently inflate the LEFT cheek with air; do not blow out.

tasks.name: PUFF_RIGHT
tasks.instruction: Gently inflate the RIGHT cheek with air; do not blow out.

tasks.name: PUFF_BOTH
tasks.instruction: Gently inflate BOTH cheeks with air; do not blow out.

tasks.name: TONGUE_CHEEK_LEFT
tasks.instruction: Push the tongue into the LEFT cheek (bulge without air); keep your head still.

tasks.name: TONGUE_CHEEK_RIGHT
tasks.instruction: Push the tongue into the RIGHT cheek (bulge without air); keep your head still.

rest.name: REST
rest.instruction: Remain relaxed. Keep the same resting head, jaw and lip pose.

control.name: REST_CONTROL
control.instruction: Remain relaxed (control: no task). Keep the same resting pose.
